```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(robustbase)
library(readxl)
data<-read_xlsx("C:\\Users\\ASUS\\Downloads\\Data Gempa.xlsx")
data
```

```{r}
x <- data$`Kedalaman (Km)`
summ <- summary(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`)
IQR <-IQR(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`)
Q <- quantile(x,prob=c(0.25,0.75))
Q1 <- Q[["25%"]]
Q3 <- Q[["75%"]]
summ
Q
```

```{r}
#medcouple
library(robustbase)
mc<-mc(x)
mc
```
```{r}
frekuensi <- table(x)
frekuensi
```

```{r}
bb <- Q1-1.5*exp(-4*mc)*IQR
bb
ba <- Q3+1.5*exp(3*mc)*IQR
ba
```

```{r}
boxplot(x)
IQR_normal <- IQR(x)
pagar_bawah <- Q1 - 1.5*IQR_normal
pagar_bawah
pagar_atas <- Q3 + 1.5*IQR_normal
pagar_atas
title(main="Normal Boxplot")
```

```{r}
adjboxStats(x)
summary(x)
```

```{r}
adjbox(x)
```

```{r}
library(psych)

describe(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = `Kedalaman (Km)`)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 35, fill = "lightyellow", color = "black") +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = mean(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`), sd = sd(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`)), color = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Histogram dan Densitas Kedalaman Gempa", x = "Kedalaman (Km)", y = "Density")+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(data$`Kedalaman (Km)`)
```
